title: The calendar is a gate
governingQuestion: How does a public timetable distribute private permission?

essay.headline: The calendar is a gate
essay.opening: The schedule is public; entry is a separate state.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: JFWO was established in 2005 and positions Fashion Week beside textile and related industry divisions.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: The current official schedule labels entries by runway, presentation, showroom or event and exposes open-to-public versus invitation-only states.

sections.heading: Next / limit
sections.copy: The public pages do not expose one universal invitation, security, seating or accessibility stack across every participating venue.

essay.closing: Tokyo’s technical identity is not one gadget. It is the chain of interfaces that decides what can enter, travel, translate, trade and remain.
